title: Rose Petal Cordial & Rose Petal Tea Cakes

ingredientSections.heading: Rose Petal Tea Cakes
items: Half of the Rose petal and lemon solids leftover from making cordial

methodSections.heading: Rose Petal Tea Cakes
steps: Thoroughly drain and chop the rose petals and lemon slices into a fine dice.

Break the cold butter into small chunks, place in a stand mixer bowl. Add the icing sugar, flour and salt. On low speed, with a paddle attachment, mix the ingredients until there is an even crumbly texture, at this point add the rose petals and lemon pieces. Mix until just combined.
Form walnut size balls and space a couple of centimetres apart on a baking sheet. Bake at 200°C (400°F) for about 10-12 minutes, take them out just as they are turning brown. Let the cakes cool.

methodSections.heading: Serve
steps: Dust with icing sugar before serving with a glass of iced Rose Petal Cordial.
